title: Re-entry from space
subtitle: NASA's FIRE II probe enters the atmosphere at 11 km/s
hook: In 1965 NASA sent a probe back into the Earth's atmosphere at eleven kilometres a second and measured the heat that reached it. Predict that heat.

media.alt: An Apollo-shaped capsule at its trim angle in a hypersonic stream, its bow shock and wake in 3D
media.caption: The lab today: an Apollo-shaped capsule at its trim angle in a hypersonic stream, the shock layer in 3D (inviscid, a perfect gas). The glow, the chemistry and the heat on the wall are what this flag adds.

note: In preparation: the cases, the outputs and their units are written here when the flag opens, and the measured values are sealed at the same moment (tools/flags.py seal).
